| description = Goblins are not native to Kunark, but during the fall of the Iksar Empire the continent saw an invasion of Goblin Lords from Faydwer. The hardy Kunark Goblins have managed a unified front that no tribe of their race in Norrath has ever achieved. Leading the Goblins of Death Mountain is Chief RokGus. His people's sworn enemy is the Brood of Di'zok - the leading faction of Sarnak.

He is infamous for dropping two famous items that are no longer in game. Found at the back of the ledge, #8 on the inner sanctum map.

No longer drops the [[Eye of RokGus]] nor [[Locket of Escape]].
